description: The declared account's Order History (class Orders) on the store, all on one page: first value per sort - order number, status, payment status asc/desc, payment type desc, date asc/desc, amount asc/desc. Read only.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the orders: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

minOrders.description: Orders the account must own on the store (at least; 2 so a sort can be seen)

maxOrders.description: Most orders allowed: the page size the test shows, so the first rows are over all orders

minStatuses.description: Distinct order statuses among the account's orders (at least). Left out: any

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
